package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// scenario for middleware_writes_business_response_payloads: Middleware that emits domain success payloads instead of leaving response bodies to handlers or render helpers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type DashboardData struct {
	TotalUsers    int       `json:"total_users"`
	ActiveUsers   int       `json:"active_users"`
	NewSignups    int       `json:"new_signups"`
	GeneratedAt   time.Time `json:"generated_at"`
}

func dashboardDataFromCache() DashboardData {
	return DashboardData{
		TotalUsers:  1024,
		ActiveUsers: 312,
		NewSignups:  17,
		GeneratedAt: time.Now(),
	}
}

func CacheResponseMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Query().Get("cached") == "true" {
			data := dashboardDataFromCache()

			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(data)
			return
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func MetricsHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

var _ = json.Marshal
